verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents online scoring, which runs scorers automatically on production traces as they are logged. That is a user-configured, event-triggered automation, but the only documented action is scoring. 'Configure monitoring' via MCP and scheduled Patterns runs add some automation, but neither is a general rules-to-actions engine. missing for 10: user-defined rule conditions/filters, arbitrary triggered actions (alerts, webhooks, dataset additions, notifications), documentation of rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
